name: feishu-next
description: Feishu/Lark workflow orchestration: connect operations with personal playbooks, evidence and validation, and navigate to official lark-suite.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Feishu operations into verifiable workflows.
interface.longDescription: Feishu Next is a workflow capability layer built from BlueSkyXN's Feishu/Lark playbooks and experience. Its bundled feishu-workflow-router explains official capabilities through on-demand domain maps, selects official basic usage or a distinct Next method, decomposes goals, coordinates dependencies, and navigates to official lark-suite or current official lark-cli guidance while preserving execution context and evidence. Router and seven playbooks stay independently discoverable; they reuse matching context and return verified outputs without recursive redispatch. Seven playbooks cover exports, document assets, chat archives, whiteboards and draw.io, text-preserving formatting, Mindnote outlines and generic Base snapshots. Next retains multi-step state instead of simply forwarding an entire task to suite. It does not copy official skills, maintain a separate Router plugin, or automatically update CLI or skill layouts. Private adapters and business data stay outside the package. The original 0.3.0 workflows were runtime-validated against lark-cli 1.0.83 and source-audited against lark-cli 1.0.86; these historical checks do not imply current installation or business acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $feishu-next:feishu-workflow-router to connect these Feishu operations and navigate to official suite as needed.
Use $feishu-next:feishu-whiteboard-ops to update or sync this Feishu whiteboard.
